_instructions: TEMPLATE for AI agents: fill in this JSON to build a quiz for quiz-maker.html.
1. meta.title / meta.title_en: quiz name shown at the top. meta.subtitle / meta.subtitle_en: optional one line under it.
2. meta.intro / meta.intro_en: optional list of extra bullet lines for the start screen (question counts are added automatically).
3. questions: array. Each item has category/category_en, question/question_en, options/options_en, correct (0-based index), explanation/explanation_en.
4. options and options_en must be the same length and same order; 'correct' points into that order.
5. Every text field has an English '_en' key. If you only have one language, you may fill just one side; the interface prefers English and falls back to the base key.
6. Remove this '_instructions' key when you are done (optional but cleaner).

meta.title: Sample Quiz
meta.subtitle: A sample quiz that shows the JSON format
meta.subtitle_en: A sample quiz that shows the JSON format
intro: Explanations are shown at the end
intro_en: Explanations are shown at the end
